dedupe_keys.name: gridded 14co2 emissions from nuclear power plants and reprocessing plants corso d3 4 nuclear component

description: This data set gives nuclear emissions of radiocarbon dioxide (14CO2) as gridded fluxes for Europe and the globe. It was published by Hannah M. Allen and Carlos Gómez-Ortiz as the nuclear component of Deliverable D3.4 of the CORSO project, the final version of its atmospheric potential oxygen and 14CO2 flux databases. An earlier record by Gómez-Ortiz, from December 2023, gives point-source CSV data and 0.5 degree gridded data preprocessed from the RADD database and Zazzeri and co-authors (2018), curated by Ida Storm at Lund University. Coverage is Europe at 0.5 by 0.5 degrees and the globe at 1 by 1 degree, with yearly resolution in becquerels per square metre per second. Files are NetCDF grids and a readme on Zenodo (December 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, and a Jupyter notebook linked from the record recalculates emissions at other resolutions or units. Caveats: gridding spreads point emissions across cells, and yearly values hide short releases. Simulation uses are atmospheric transport modelling and environmental impact assessment around nuclear facilities. Related records: data-nuclear-gaseous-radiocarbon-emissions-1950-2023 compiles facility-level values.
